messages:
Mason Reed: Quick RFC follow-up — pack scheduler priority: should we favor shape stability (fewer re-shapes) over tail latency for small tenants? thinking about probe budget spend and warmup churn.

Kai Park: I'm leaning towards stability for small tenants. Reshaping frequently causes cache thrash and prefill spikes. But we need a clear latency SLO cutoff.

Sarah Nguyen: Agree re cache thrash. We saw a 12% P95 bump when prefill churned last week on staging.

April Chen: Proposal: add tenant class threshold: if tenant_qps < 0.5 -> prefer_stable_shapes=true. Put a hard cap on probe_budget for small tenants.

Liam Ortiz: should we implement as heuristic in scheduler or during kernel-autotune? if scheduler knows 'stable' flag it can avoid shape-promoting merges.

Mason Reed: idea: two flags: prefer_stable_shapes + max_probe_rate. runtime picks either stable or latency-optimized packer. Keep rollout via feature flag.

autotune-bot: probe-run finished 2024-11-12 09:15 UTC — sample: 1200 probes, 18% effective shape reduction, avg probe cost 3.6ms

Kai Park: config sketch:
```
pack_scheduler:
  prefer_stable_shapes: true
  max_probe_rate: 0.01
  warmup_prefill: 3
```

Sarah Nguyen: Need metrics: shape_change_rate, probe_success_rate, p95_latency_delta. Prefer we gate on shape_change_rate < 0.05 for stability mode.

April Chen: Also eviction policy: if cache_evictions increase > 10/min switch to transient-mode and reduce probing.

Liam Ortiz: runtime concerns: implementing transient-mode will need an eviction hook and quick telemetry—small perf cost but localised.

Mason Reed: Action items:
- @April to prototype tenant threshold logic + telemetry (ETA 3d)
- @Kai to add metrics to dashboards (ETA 2d)
- @Sarah to run canary on staging with 10% traffic (ETA after patch)

April Chen: ack

Kai Park: ack

Sarah Nguyen: ack, will schedule canary once infra patch lands

Mason Reed: If no objections, I'll open a short RFC PR describing config knobs and rollout plan.

Kai Park: :thumbsup:

autotune-bot: rollout flag 'stable-shape-mode' created
